tooltip.mcrgb.shift_prompt: Hold SHIFT to view color info
ui.mcrgb.refresh_info: Click me after changing resource packs or adding mods! 😀
option.mcrgb.readJsonFile: Read Colour Info from JSON File
tooltip.mcrgb.always_show_in_tooltips: Controls whether color info is displayed in item tooltips outside of the color picker UI.
tooltip.mcrgb.slider_constant_update: Set this to 'Update After Scrolling' if you experience stuttering/lag while using RGB sliders.
tooltip.mcrgb.give_command:
The command MCRGB will use to give you items.
The following delimiters will be substituted for the respective fields:
%p - Player Name
%i  - Item ID
%c - Item Components
%q - Quantity

Useful on servers with custom commands.
tooltip.mcrgb.bypass_op: Bypass checks for creative mode and operator status when giving items to the player. Useful on servers with custom permissions.
tooltip.mcrgb.readJsonFile:
False: Disables reading colour info from JSON file at launch. 
Leave this set to False, unless you notice issues with loading.
tooltip.mcrgb.maxTooltipLines:
The maximum number of lines to display in the tooltip when hovering over an item.
Note: The actual number of lines may slightly exceed this number. This is intended behaviour.
tooltip.mcrgb.colour_mode:
The method used to determine block colors.

MEAN - The average color. (What the block looks like from a distance.)
MEDIAN - The most prominent color in the texture.
MCRGB - A custom algorithm which displays multiple dominant colours, and the percentage which each colour occupies in the texture.
tooltip.mcrgb.creative_give:
Choose how to spawn in items from the MCRGB UI.

 Creative Drag - Allows you to drag items from the MCRGB UI into your hotbar similar to the Creative Mode Inventory.
 Give Command - Spawns in items using a /give command.
 View Only - Unable to spawn in items.
warning.mcrgb.noclothconfig: Cloth Config is required to access settings in-game. Edit the config.json manually or install Cloth Config.
